1_wiring_shape.choice: Reuse DualSpaceSDRPHead with SDRP-live. Do NOT build a new dehydron head on z_hyp.
1_wiring_shape.why: Only path already empirically confirmed to route gradient into attn_layers/projector/moe/sdrp_head (grad_attribution_check positive control). A new head would be unverified wiring risk.
1_wiring_shape.intentional_leak: SDRP target remains edge-type-histogram-derived (same leakage family as dehydron labels). For G_fit this is intentional: capacity probe given the answer. Remains non-claim-bearing and does NOT close defect B.
1_wiring_shape.moe_mode_why: Experts still receive gradient under ablation (gate frozen, routing fixed). Router health is moe_verify_on_pool — do not conflate.

2_loss_coeffs.why_sole_sdrp: Zero dehydron and margin so SDRP is the only active task loss — no ambiguity which term drove spine gradient. Adam normalizes by grad variance; sole-contributor matters more than 0.1 vs 1.0 scale.

3_step_budget.extensions: FORBIDDEN without a new sealed prereg
3_step_budget.why: Spine modules share lr_hyperbolic=1e-3 with the euc_skip/mechanism_head group that already moved substantially in 400 steps once they had gradient. 400 is a precedented starting budget at that LR — not a guarantee. Whatever the run shows at exactly 400 steps is the result; no 'extend to 800 because still climbing'.

4_frontend.why_not_pool: equiformer_pool_frontend.py deletes edge_index/edge_type — cannot carry the leaked typed signal this G_fit depends on; would silently become untyped-only again.
4_frontend.policy: disclosed, pre-registered, cheap, harness-diagnostic-only (SSOT SE(3)-lite pilot policy)
4_frontend.typed_means: edge_type reaches the model via lite rel_bias/scatter. Prior reachability check found weak effect on euc_skip path; recheck type-sensitivity after spine has gradient (trained spine may use the channel differently).

5_grad_fixture_first.order: Build and pass gradient-reachability fixture BEFORE any 400-step training run is allowed to start.
5_grad_fixture_first.fixture: Small synthetic model (sprint unit-test dims), one forward/backward, no PDB I/O, reuse per-bucket grad-norm wrapper from grad_attribution_check.
5_grad_fixture_first.assert_not_in_graph_when_coeff_zero: dehydron/margin paths with coeff=0 must show grad is None (not merely 0.0) where structurally disconnected; distinguish 'not in graph' vs 'in graph but zeroed' as in grad_attribution_check.
5_grad_fixture_first.fail: ABORT_WIRING — do not start the 400-step card run

_log_c.justification: model.forward detaches curvature to a Python float (c_val = float(self.curvature().detach()...)) and DualSpaceSDRPHead uses bound float self.c — _log_c is not in the autograd graph under current trunk. Freeze addendum item #16 (learned c / document pin) remains a SEPARATE card. This G_fit does not silently claim learned-c training.
_log_c.log: Record final softplus(_log_c) vs init; expect drift ~0. Nonzero drift is an anomaly → ABORT_WIRING investigation.

clip_fraction.definition: fraction of steps where pre-clip grad norm > max_grad_norm (and the pre-clip / post-clip norms)
clip_fraction.why: INSTR last step had pre-clip 2.75 vs max 1.0 with only euc_skip/mechanism_head active. Once spine contributes, clip will likely bind harder and shrink effective per-parameter updates — needed to separate 'flat because clipped/spread' from 'no signal' at the fixed 400-step budget.

held_out_baseline_locked_at_draft.note: Prior dehydron euc_skip held-out lift band (0.97–1.21) is context for why dehydron-only G_fit failed to generalise — NOT the metric of this card (dehydron_coeff=0).
held_out_baseline_locked_at_draft.this_card_metric: SDRP top-1 accuracy lift vs majority-class rate (see pass_fail_bars.lift_definition)

loss_coeffs.moe_balance_under_ablation: inactive / constant — not a task loss

protocol.split: leave-one-structure-out (LOSO), 12 folds — folds_frozen.json; train 11, eval 1 held-out
protocol.why_12: Held-out bars reuse Arm B S1/S2 shape (structure-level bootstrap n=12).
protocol.batch_reduction: mean over 11 train structures (same as run_epoch_mean_structures)
protocol.device_stop: If CUDA unavailable: STOP. No CPU fallback.

metrics_logged: per train/held-out structure: SDRP top-1 accuracy, majority_rate, lift=acc/majority_rate, macro-F1 (present classes)
per-bucket grad_l2 and drift every 10 steps
clip: preclip_norm, postclip_norm, clip_active every 10 steps; clip_active_fraction over the run
curvature softplus(_log_c) init vs final (expect ~0 drift)
post-train edge_type shuffle sensitivity on mechanism_score AND on sdrp_logits (diagnostic; typed channel recheck)

pass_fail_bars.status: LOCKED at draft with decisions — not adjustable after seeing results without a new signed card
pass_fail_bars.lift_definition: per structure, last step: SDRP_top1_accuracy / majority_class_rate. Majority classifier has lift = 1.0 by construction.
pass_fail_bars.G_finite: no non-finite loss or gradient in any fold

G_grad_spine.when: gradient-reachability fixture (decision 5) AND step-0 of each fold under card coeffs
G_grad_spine.require_none_not_zero_for_disabled: with dehydron_coeff=0 and margin_coeff=0, mechanism_head dehydron path must not be required to carry task loss; spine must still light via SDRP CE

G_fit_train.metric: per-structure train SDRP top-1 accuracy at last step
G_fit_train.bar: macro-mean over the 11 train structures of lift (acc/majority_rate) >= 1.30 AND min train-structure lift >= 1.10

S1_mean_lift.bar: mean over the 12 held-out structures of lift >= 1.30, AND the lower bound of a 95% percentile bootstrap CI (structure-level resampling, 10000 draws, seed 0) is > 1.10

verdict_table.ABORT_WIRING: G_grad_spine fails (fixture or step-0) OR unexpected _log_c drift — harness/wiring still wrong
verdict_table.INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT: G_finite and G_grad_spine pass; G_fit_train fails
verdict_table.FAIL_NO_SIGNAL: G_finite and G_grad_spine and G_fit_train pass; S1 or S2 fails
verdict_table.PASS_SIGNAL: G_finite and G_grad_spine and G_fit_train and S1 and S2 — capacity probe only; see not_claims
